title: Algebra 2 — MP4 QAM
assessment_goal: Determine whether students can apply Algebra 2 concepts — polynomial operations, functions, statistics, trigonometry, and advanced algebraic reasoning — to solve multi-step problems.

tasks.title: Identify the study design
tasks.question: A veterinarian pharmaceutical company is testing a new drug to treat an infection among puppies. The puppies are randomly placed into two equally-sized groups. One group will receive the drug and the other group will receive a placebo. The veterinarians monitor the puppies. This is an example of:

tasks.title: Solve a radical equation
tasks.question: Solve algebraically for x: √(2x − 7) + x = 5
tasks.hint: Isolate the radical, square both sides, then check for extraneous solutions.

tasks.title: Complex number expansion
tasks.question: Given that i is the imaginary unit, the expression (x − 2i)² is equivalent to:

tasks.title: Factor polynomials
tasks.question: Factor completely: a) 3x² − 2x − 5  b) 2x² + 3x − 9
tasks.hint: Use the AC method or trial and error for each quadratic.

tasks.title: Solve exponential equation
tasks.question: Solve algebraically for x and round your solution to the nearest tenth: 87e^(0.3x) − 10 = 5918
tasks.hint: Isolate the exponential, take the natural log of both sides.

tasks.title: Rational exponents
tasks.question: Rewrite in simplest form using rational exponents: ∛(81x⁴y⁻⁸z⁶) / 12
tasks.hint: Convert the cube root to a rational exponent and simplify each variable.

tasks.title: Function intersection
tasks.question: Given q(x) = 1 and r(x) = |x − 12| − 3, what is an approximate solution of q(x) = r(x)?

tasks.title: System of three equations
tasks.question: Consider the system: x + 2y − z = 1, −x − 3y + 2z = 0, 2x − 4y + z = 10. What is the solution set?

tasks.title: Factor theorem proof
tasks.question: Algebraically determine whether x + 4 is a factor of 2x³ + 10x² + 4x − 16. Justify your answer.
tasks.correctAnswer: Yes, x + 4 is a factor because f(−4) = 0 by the Factor Theorem.
tasks.hint: Evaluate f(−4). If it equals 0, then x + 4 is a factor.

tasks.title: Complete polynomial factoring
tasks.question: Over the set of integers, factor completely: x⁴ + 4x³ − 9x² − 36x
tasks.hint: Factor out x first, then factor by grouping, then use difference of squares.

tasks.title: Independence of events
tasks.question: The probability that Felipe wins is 22/45. The probability that they practice for a long time is 27/45. The probability that Felipe wins and they practice for a long time is 12/45. Determine whether the two events are independent. Justify.
tasks.hint: Two events are independent if P(A∩B) = P(A)·P(B).

tasks.title: Trigonometric graphing
tasks.question: Graph at least one cycle of y = 3cos(4x) − 2. Find amplitude, period, and midline.
tasks.hint: For y = A·cos(Bx) + D: amplitude = |A|, period = 2π/|B|, midline y = D.

tasks.title: Parabola from focus and directrix
tasks.question: The equation of the parabola with focus at (−3, 2) and directrix y = 0 is:
tasks.hint: Find the vertex (midpoint between focus and directrix) and use (x−h)² = 4p(y−k).

tasks.title: Identify the sequence formula
tasks.question: Which function defines the sequence −6, −10, −14, −18, ..., where f(6) = −26?
